# samdev-pulse — Complete API & System Reference

## Overview
samdev-pulse is an open-source, production-ready GitHub profile README widget that compiles developer metrics across multiple platforms into an aesthetic, vector SVG image.

Base URL: `https://samdev-pulse.vercel.app/api/profile`

---

## Query Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `username` | string | `SamXop123` | Target GitHub username (required for personalized stats). |
| `theme` | string | `dark` | Visual color palette (see themes below). |
| `leetcode` | string | `""` | LeetCode username to display problem-solving metrics (Easy/Medium/Hard + Contest Rating/Ranking). |
| `codeforces`| string | `""` | Codeforces handle to display rating and rank. |
| `codechef` | string | `""` | CodeChef username to display rating, division, and stars. |
| `align` | string | `left` | Alignment mode for SVG elements (`left`, `center`). |
| `hide_trophies` | boolean | `false` | Set to `true` to omit the achievement trophy row. |

---

## Supported Themes (25+ Palettes)

- `dark`: Default sleek dark theme with violet accents
- `light`: Clean light mode with soft indigo accents
- `tokyonight`: Vibrant Tokyo Night editor theme
- `dracula`: Classic vampire dark theme
- `catppuccin`: Soothing pastel aesthetic (Mocha flavor)
- `nord`: Arctic, north-bluish clean palette
- `synthwave84`: Retro 80s neon synthwave with glowing purples
- `one-dark`: Atom One Dark theme
- `onedarkpro`: VS Code One Dark Pro theme
- `material`: Google Material Design dark palette
- `monokai`: High-contrast coding classic
- `gruvbox`: Warm retro groove theme
- `solarized`: Precision color scheme for code
- `rose-pine`: Minimalist, warm pine aesthetic
- `aurora`: Northern lights teal & green gradient
- `midnight-sunset`: Deep twilight and warm amber
- `forestnight`: Calming deep greens and earthen tones
- `oceanicnext`: Deep ocean teal & blue palette
- `emberglow`: Warm fireplace embers and orange gradients
- `midnightneon`: Ultra-high-contrast cyberpunk neon
- `pasteldream`: Soft aesthetic pastel colors
- `androidstudio`: JetBrains / Android Studio dark IDE styling
- `xcode`: Apple Xcode developer palette
- `webdev`: Full-stack JavaScript and TypeScript inspired theme
- `aiml`: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning neural theme
- `gamedev`: Arcade and Unreal/Unity engine aesthetic
- `cobalt2`: Wes Bos Cobalt2 vibrant blue theme
- `github-light`: Official GitHub light theme style
- `hc-light`: High contrast light mode (WCAG AAA compliant)
- `hc-dark`: High contrast dark mode (WCAG AAA compliant)

---

## Markdown Integration Examples

### Basic GitHub Profile Card
```markdown
<div align="center">
  <img src="https://samdev-pulse.vercel.app/api/profile?username=SamXop123&theme=tokyonight" alt="GitHub Profile Stats" />
</div>
```

### Full Competitive Programming + Custom Theme
```markdown
![Developer Pulse](https://samdev-pulse.vercel.app/api/profile?username=SamXop123&theme=catppuccin&leetcode=Dot_NotSam&codeforces=tourist&align=center)
```

---

## Architecture & Hosting
- **Backend Runtime**: Node.js ES Modules on Vercel Serverless Functions.
- **Rendering Engine**: Native SVG generation with embedded SVGs, responsive layout engine, and zero external binary dependencies.
- **Caching**: Multi-tiered in-memory LRU cache with deduplication to ensure rapid sub-second responses and respect upstream API rate limits.
